name: OPOVD: Delo o propavshey sakharnitse
source:
The DFPIC takes on its final case.
After the stamp and the ladle, the camp seemingly should have gotten used to the fact that any trivial matter in Sovyonok can suddenly become a camp-wide incident.
But even absurdity has a limit. Probably.
A new case begins with yet another disappearance: A sugar bowl has gone missing from the dining hall.
An ordinary sugar bowl? Perhaps.
But not when morning tea, camp order, and the very existence of the DFPIC are at stake.
Semyon once again finds himself at the head of the department, although he still hopes this was a temporary mistake.
Elektronik is keeping the minutes again.
Ulyana is once again taking what is happening too seriously.
Or vice versa - not seriously enough.
This time, the investigation will be the final test for the DFPIC.
If the sugar bowl is found, the department will prove it is needed by the camp. If not, it will be disbanded.
And then everything goes on as usual: Suspicions, strange clues, dubious conclusions, sugar trails, very important conversations, and a case that gradually becomes something more than just a search for a missing item.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3719797745]Steam[/url]]
translation:
DFPIC受理其最终案件。
在邮票和钢包之后，集中营似乎应该习惯这样一个事实：索维约诺克的任何小事都可能突然成为整个集中营的事件。
但即使是荒谬也有一个限度。大概。
一个新案件始于另一起失踪事件：食堂里的一个糖罐失踪了。
一个普通的糖罐？也许。
但当早茶、营地秩序以及DFPIC的生存受到威胁时，情况就不同了。
谢苗再次担任部门负责人，尽管他仍然希望这只是暂时的错误。
Elektronik再次进行会议记录。
乌里安娜再次对正在发生的事情过于认真。
反之亦然——不够认真。
此次调查将是对DFPIC的最后考验。
如果找到糖罐，该部门将证明营地需要它。如果没有，它将被解散。
然后一切都像往常一样进行：怀疑、奇怪的线索、可疑的结论、糖迹、非常重要的对话，以及一个逐渐不仅仅是寻找失踪物品的案件。
